name: Overcal
tagline: Open your agenda, world clocks, and next-meeting countdown from the menu bar.
description:
Overcal puts a compact month view and upcoming agenda in the Mac menu bar. It is geared toward checking the next appointment, joining a call, and comparing time zones without leaving the current app.

## Features
- Browse the month and inspect the day's events.
- See a countdown and open the meeting link when available.
- Keep clocks for other time zones alongside the agenda.

## Privacy and requirements
Overcal requires macOS 26 and asks for access to calendar events to build the agenda.

## Pricing
Overcal costs $7.99 as a one-time purchase.
